accepted_objections: Exact margin ranking requires the omitted slab bytes and is not a pre-read runtime selector.
Layer 92 has a tractable but nonlinear tail: routed RMS/up, hidden-dependent AttnRes softmax, final RMS, and vocabulary projection.
Same-screen margin ranking is label-derived mechanistic evidence and cannot validate a selector.
Full-vocabulary KL alone is insufficient at a structured-token boundary; margin alone is also insufficient and can hide broader distribution damage.
Existing KL-ranked group measurements do not replace the four newly frozen margin-ranked compositions.

modified_protocol.first_stop: If no equal-B24 margin-ranked group recovers teacher top1 or makes teacher-versus-contender margin positive, stop static B24 selection work at layer 92 and move to complement or progressive rescue.
modified_protocol.gate_b: Only after Gate A passes, build a captured nonlinear-tail discriminator. It must rank before unranked authoritative bytes are read and must beat local held-out correlation without refitting.

production: No promotion. Any later passing primitive must be narrowly reimplemented and requalified on perf/k3-production-ponytail.
